answer: Walnut Canyon Timing Gate. Each new agent identity must complete N outbound actions whose inter-arrival times follow a server-chosen random profile; the request stream is normalized into a traffic-shape signal compared against that profile, and identities whose shape diverges by more than a fixed tolerance are rate-limited and quarantined. An attacker running M sybils must pace each one independently against a fresh profile, so wall-clock cost scales linearly with M and parallel spoofing is exposed by synchronized timing.
